description.fun: Wurmple is a coin toss on ten stubby legs: whether it becomes Silcoon and then Beautifly, or Cascoon and then Dustox, rests on a hidden number nobody can see, so you only find out when it happens. Ken Sugimori designed it as Hoenn's answer to Caterpie, a simple bug to teach new players how evolution works.
description.guide: A caterpillar Pokémon of Hoenn's forests that clings to branches with suction-pad feet and fends off predators with poison from its tail spikes. It evolves into either Silcoon or Cascoon, decided by a hidden value no Trainer can see.
description.tagline: Hoenn's evolutionary coin toss: butterfly or moth, and nobody knows which.

branches.text: Both paths start at level 7, and nothing you can see or do decides which one Wurmple takes: it rests on its personality value, a hidden number fixed for good. It's the only Pokémon whose evolution works this way.

description.fun: Silcoon wraps itself in white silk tied to a branch, peering out through two little holes and moving as little as possible, saving the energy it stored as Wurmple for its next evolution. Dew and rainwater collecting on the silk keep it fed. It's a near twin of Cascoon, with the same type, moves and shape, and it becomes Beautifly just three levels later.
description.guide: A Bug-type cocoon Pokémon wrapped in white silk, one of Wurmple's two possible evolutions. It hangs from branches and barely moves while it saves energy. It evolves into Beautifly at level 10.
description.tagline: A white silk cocoon that sips the dew while it waits

description.fun: Beautifly looks lovely, but it's aggressive and greedy: disturb it while it's gathering pollen and it will jab you with its long, curled proboscis, which it also uses to suck up fruit juice and even its prey's bodily fluids. It rides the spring winds in search of flowers and competes with Combee for nectar. Its Japanese name, Agehunt, adds 'hunt' to the word for swallowtail butterfly.
description.guide: A Bug- and Flying-type butterfly Pokémon based on the swallowtail, one of Wurmple's two final forms. It feeds on pollen and nectar but is aggressive when disturbed. It evolves from Silcoon at level 10.
description.tagline: A pretty butterfly with a greedy streak and a sharp proboscis

description.fun: Cascoon hides under leaves and in the forks of branches, camouflaged with dead leaves stuck to its purple silk, and it won't budge even when attacked. But it never forgets the pain, and seeks revenge once it evolves. Its silk is said to be finer and glossier than Silcoon's and is made into high-quality clothing. Inside, it heats up as evolution nears.
description.guide: A Bug-type cocoon Pokémon wrapped in purple silk, one of Wurmple's two possible evolutions. It camouflages itself with dead leaves and endures attacks without moving. It evolves into Dustox at level 10.
description.tagline: A purple cocoon that holds still and holds a grudge

description.fun: Dustox is a nocturnal moth that can't resist bright lights: swarms descend on cities at night and strip the leaves off roadside trees. When attacked it sheds toxic scales from its wings, strong enough to make even a professional wrestler ill, which makes the swarms hard to drive away. It seems to be based on Japan's pale green luna moths.
description.guide: A Bug- and Poison-type moth Pokémon, one of Wurmple's two final forms. It is nocturnal, drawn to light, and scatters toxic scales from its wings when attacked. It evolves from Cascoon at level 10.
description.tagline: A night moth drawn to city lights, scattering toxic dust
